share.revokeConfirm: Turn this link off? Anyone already holding it will stop being able to open the post.
share.createError: Could not create the link. Please try again.
share.revokeError: Could not turn the link off. Please try again.

toast.duplicateError: Could not duplicate the post. Please try again.

errors.retryError: Could not retry this post. Please try again.
errors.retryConflict: This post is no longer retryable — it may have been retried already, or has since published.

empty.all: No posts yet. Compose one and it will show up here.
empty.DRAFT: No drafts. Anything you start without scheduling lands here.
empty.ERROR: Nothing has failed to publish. That is the good outcome.

list.loadError: Could not load the list of posts.

calendar.removeConfirmRepeating: Delete this post? It is the next occurrence of a repeating post, so deleting it also stops the series.

tags.title: Tags
tags.empty: No tags yet. Create one to group and filter your posts.
tags.removeConfirm: Delete "{name}"? It will come off {count} post(s) — the posts themselves stay.
tags.removeConfirmUnused: Delete "{name}"? No post is using it.
tags.loadError: Could not load the tags. Please try again.
tags.saveError: Could not save the tag. Please try again.
tags.removeError: Could not delete the tag. Please try again.

sets.title: Channel sets
sets.intro: A set is a saved group of channels. Pick it once in the editor instead of ticking the same channels on every post.
sets.emptyHint: Create one below, or save your current selection straight from the post editor.
sets.noChannels: Connect a channel first — a set is a shortcut for choosing between them.
sets.orphaned: No channels left in this set — its channels were disconnected. Add at least one to be able to save it.
sets.removeConfirm: Delete "{name}"? It is only a shortcut for choosing channels — no post and no channel is affected.
sets.loadError: Could not load the sets. Please try again.
sets.saveError: Could not save the set. Please try again.
sets.removeError: Could not delete the set. Please try again.

signatures.title: Signatures
signatures.intro: A signature is a saved tail — contacts, a disclaimer, a call to subscribe. The editor appends the one you pick to the last segment of a channel's thread.
signatures.emptyHint: Write one below. Whatever you save here shows up in the post editor's per-channel picker.
signatures.defaultHint: An organization has at most one default signature — making this one the default takes the mark off whichever signature holds it now.
signatures.removeConfirm: Delete this signature? Posts that already carry its text keep it — only the saved signature goes away.
signatures.loadError: Could not load the signatures. Please try again.
signatures.saveError: Could not save the signature. Please try again.
signatures.removeError: Could not delete the signature. Please try again.

comments.title: Comments
comments.intro: Internal to your team — nothing here is published or shown on a shared link.
comments.emptyHint: Leave a note for whoever picks this post up next.
comments.loadError: Could not load the comments. Please try again.
comments.sendError: Could not send the comment. Your text is still here — try again.

impersonating.label: You are working as {name}.
impersonating.hint: Everything you do here is recorded as them.
impersonating.stopError: Could not end the impersonation session. Please try again.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Every account on this instance. Sign in as one of them to see exactly what they see.
users.emptyHint: Try part of a name, or the address they signed up with.
users.loadError: Could not load the users. Please try again.

errors.forbidden: Only a superadmin can start an impersonation session.
errors.nested: You are already impersonating someone. Go back to your own account first.
errors.actorGone: The account you were impersonating from no longer exists. Please sign in again.
errors.generic: Could not sign in as that user. Please try again.
